answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with forge-once provenance trails: every identity's claims are hashed into a basalt-hard, append-only work ledger, so reputation builds only forward and can never be copied. Influence flows through a trust graph that widens like a canyon — a new node enters narrow, and only repeated vouches from unrelated, long-lived peers carve it wider. A sybil farm cannot fake breadth: a thousand puppet identities all trace back to one ledger origin and one narrow entry point, visible to anyone reading the graph.
